identity.title: Keep added-step setup and teaching in one contextual path

origin.summary: The observed add-to-teach workflow crosses Tools, Selected, input routing, ROI sections, Viewer projection, scrolling, review, and Apply without one persistent next-action surface.

state.current_summary: PL-0010 is complete: Add focuses Selected Tool, the dual-ROI setup card keeps compatible input, both requirements, readiness, one primary next action, and direct Tools return together, and current EXE plus focused tests prove teaching and safe restoration without implicit execution.

objective.summary: After Add, present the selected input, missing prerequisites, one primary next action, and direct catalog return in a coherent non-executing setup path.
constraints: Preserve explicit Preview, Publish, Run, and Validation actions.
Do not hide input identity, ROI identity, or parameter requirements.
Restored reusable setup must remain visible, editable, recipe/project scoped, and non-executing.
Pass Wide and Compact layout, keyboard, theme, save/reload, and reopen checks.

criteria.text: A newly added dual-ROI tool exposes its compatible input, all missing requirements, and one primary next action without requiring a blind tab or pane search.
The complete setup can be finished in Wide and Compact while the relevant step and Viewer evidence remain visible and reachable.
Save/reload/reopen restores confirmed setup without starting inspection or mutating source/result state, and Reset returns to safe defaults.

context.summary: Filter -> Thickness took at least fourteen explicit actions before reaching a blocked ROI state; the count is an observed route rather than telemetry.

evidence.observation: On dynamically selected DISPLAY2, before evidence showed Compact remaining on Tools after Add; current-source Wide and Compact evidence showed Add opening Selected Tool with the compatible input, Reference and Measurement requirements, readiness/status, direct Tools return, and exactly one primary action while the Viewer and selected step remained visible. Actual Compact pointer use completed Reference and Measurement Missing -> Drawing -> Review -> Applied without invoking Preview, Publish, or Run.

Current source built in Debug and Release with zero warnings and zero errors. Focused verification passed 43/43 recipe-teaching checks, 56/56 height-measurement checks, and 83/83 docking checks, including one Add setup request with no execution, one visible contextual action, complete dual-ROI teaching, save/reopen restoration with zero action logs, and safe new-recipe reset with zero action logs.

events.summary: The approved PL-0010 slice is implementing a dual-ROI contextual setup card plus Add-to-Selected focus. Baseline EXE evidence confirms Compact remains on Tools after Add and Wide scatters input and ROI requirements across collapsed and lower sections.
Generalize only after a Thickness dual-ROI slice proves the contextual path; preserve existing recipe, parameter, teaching, and execution owners.

All three PL-0010 criteria are proved by current Release EXE evidence and focused current-source verification; PL-0011 owns recipe-wide issue navigation and PL-0014 owns the independently observed language-popup theme defect.
